blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Alex Eala entered the WTA top 15 to end her breakthrough season. Eala, who began the year at No. 50, set a new career-high ranking of 15th in the world after a runner-up finish at the Hong Kong Open on Sunday. The 21-year-old Eala was favored in the final against unseeded American Claire Liu, who defied the odds with a 6-3, 6-0 victory to claim her maiden crown.
